% VAFT diagram template (TikZ renderer).
% Authored source: the colours and styles every vaft.diagram scene refers to.
% The renderer replaces the body-slot line inside tikzpicture with generated drawing
% commands; nothing else in this file is generated.
\def\pgfsysdriver{pgfsys-dvisvgm.def}
\documentclass[tikz,border=4pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta}
\definecolor{islandblue}{RGB}{28,103,210}
\definecolor{islanddark}{RGB}{22,55,116}
\definecolor{qblue}{RGB}{96,164,232}
\definecolor{meshgray}{RGB}{150,150,150}
\definecolor{chartblue}{RGB}{16,24,140}
\definecolor{driftred}{RGB}{214,48,39}
\tikzset{
  >=Latex,
  every picture/.style={line cap=round,line join=round,font=\large},
  lcfs/.style={line width=0.95pt},
  surface/.style={gray!55,line width=0.42pt},
  rational/.style={islandblue!80!black,dashed,line width=0.65pt},
  passing/.style={islandblue!45,line width=0.5pt},
  island/.style={islandblue,line width=0.52pt},
  separatrix/.style={islandblue,line width=0.95pt},
  opoint/.style={fill=islandblue},
  xpoint/.style={draw=islanddark,line width=0.8pt},
  width arrow/.style={<->,line width=0.65pt},
  leader/.style={->,line width=0.55pt},
  axis/.style={->,line width=0.65pt},
  label/.style={},
  title/.style={font=\huge},
  subtitle/.style={font=\normalsize,text=black!75},
  note/.style={font=\normalsize,text=gray!75!black,align=center},
  o locus/.style={islandblue,line width=1.15pt},
  x locus/.style={islanddark,densely dashed,line width=0.95pt},
  o locus hidden/.style={islandblue,line width=0.7pt,opacity=0.3},
  x locus hidden/.style={islanddark,densely dashed,line width=0.6pt,opacity=0.3},
  mesh/.style={meshgray,line width=0.35pt},
  mesh hidden/.style={meshgray,line width=0.3pt,opacity=0.3},
  machine/.style={line width=0.95pt},
  machine fill/.style={fill=gray!6,draw=none},
  hole/.style={fill=white,draw=none},
  cut/.style={black!70,dash dot,line width=0.7pt},
  inset frame/.style={draw=black!25,rounded corners=2pt},
  chart axis/.style={->,line width=1.4pt},
  boundary/.style={chartblue,line width=1.9pt},
  approx/.style={gray!70!black,dashed,line width=0.9pt},
  region/.style={font=\LARGE,align=center},
  xlabel/.style={font=\LARGE},
  ylabel/.style={font=\LARGE,rotate=90},
  tick/.style={line width=0.7pt},
  ticklabel/.style={font=\normalsize},
  star/.style={fill=black,draw=none},
  orbit ion/.style={islandblue,line width=0.9pt},
  orbit electron/.style={islanddark,line width=0.9pt},
  orbit tip/.style={->,islandblue,line width=0.9pt},
  drift/.style={->,driftred,line width=1.6pt},
  drift ion/.style={->,islandblue,line width=1.6pt},
  drift electron/.style={->,driftred,line width=1.6pt},
  exb/.style={->,black!80,line width=1.8pt},
  vector/.style={->,black,line width=1.1pt},
  field vector/.style={->,islanddark,line width=1.6pt},
  field arrow/.style={->,black!70,line width=1.2pt},
  field line/.style={islanddark,line width=1.6pt},
  field line arrow/.style={->,islanddark,line width=1.6pt},
  guiding centre/.style={driftred,dashed,line width=1.0pt},
  frame axis/.style={black!60,line width=0.8pt},
  frame axis arrow/.style={->,black!60,line width=0.8pt},
  region box/.style={black,line width=1.0pt},
  current/.style={->,driftred,line width=1.8pt},
  torus rim/.style={black,line width=1.2pt},
  section fill/.style={draw=black,line width=1.4pt,fill=qblue!18},
  charge/.style={draw,circle,inner sep=0.8pt,font=\normalsize},
  charge small/.style={font=\large},
  legend symbol/.style={font=\LARGE},
  small label/.style={font=\normalsize},
  formula box/.style={draw=black!25,rounded corners=2pt,fill=white,align=center,inner sep=5pt,font=\normalsize},
}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
%%VAFT-BODY%%
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
